 (BY SHRI S. K. RAI-GOVERNMENT ADVOCATE)
 This application coming on for admission this day, the co  following:
 ORDER

This is fourth bail application filed by the applicant under Section 439 of the Cr.P.C. for grant of regular bail relating to FIR No. 1013/2021 dated 26.08.2021 registered at Police Station-Kolgawan,
District-Satna for the offence under Sections 376 and 506 of IPC.
A s prayed by learned counsel for the applicant, this fourth bail application filed on behalf of applicant-Lavkush Dahiya is dismissed as withdrawn and not pressed.

However, as prayed by learned counsel for the applicant, learned trial Court is directed to conclude the trial expeditiously as early as possible within a period of 6 months from the date of receipt/production of copy of this order.
